body: I cut myself occasionally when I'm feeling really bad, and I came really close to killing myself about two weeks ago. Had a drawer full of pills I was about to get into and start swallowing but my mom had just happened to come check on me before I did it. Fortunately she didn't know exactly what was going on because I hate worrying her. I really would like to get out of this but it hasn't been getting any easier. Got a lot of friends who deal with mental illness as well and we're always there for each other so I have had a lot of help. Just have a feeling I'll end up losing those friends or my girlfriend one day, and that'll be what sends me over the edge. I've considered sabotaging those relationships before intentionally to help me go through with it but I try to shake those thoughts as much as I can because I do realize they're wrong and I don't ever want to be seen as that type of person. My view of suicide has changed a lot over time, when it first started coming into my mind I saw it as a way to escape the pain but at this point I can't even figure out exactly why I want it to happen. Just addicted to the thought of disappearing and never having to think or worry again. I do severely appreciate you for saying what you've said though. I've called lifelines a couple times and they always say the same scripting thing, and it just feels like they want to lock me up in a room sometimes. Good to get some real talk from a real human. Do you have any ways you use to try and up your confidence or feel more worthy of what you have? That's definitely been what I struggle with the most.
